label: exploratory
description: M3 re-run of the EXP-001 smoke matrix (protocol section 5) at the M3 revision, identical to smoke.json except the output directory: 3 arms x 1 cell (rho=1, eta=0.3, r=1, N=200) x 5 seeds, T=1000, t_d=500, W=500. Exploratory seeds 101-105, disjoint from the confirmatory seeds 1001-1020. Checks reproduction of the pre-freeze smoke and metric validation; never pooled with confirmatory results.
